name: Stormbringer: Ionic Aura raises all five power pools (#3147)
contract: #3147: Ionic Aura (707652) reads "Increases the maximum mana, Rage, Energy, Focus, and Runic Power of allies within $a1 yds by $s1%", where $a1 is radius index 23 = 40 yd and $s1 is EffectBasePoints 2 + EffectDieSides 1 = 3. Spell.dbc encodes only two of the five pools: Effect[0] and Effect[1] are SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID with aura 132 SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_ENERGY_PERCENT and MiscValue 0 (mana) and 1 (Rage), handled natively by AuraEffect::HandleAuraModIncreaseEnergyPercent; Effect[2] is an unscripted SPELL_AURA_DUMMY on the caster. Energy, Focus and Runic Power therefore received nothing, and no free effect slot was left to encode them. The fix applies the same TOTAL_PCT modifier to those three UnitMods from an aura script on every unit the raid aura reaches, mirroring what the native handler does for mana and Rage. Expected maxima come from Unit::GetCreatePowers for a class-16 player: Rage 1000, Energy 100, Runic Power 1000, Focus 0 (only a Ranger has Focus, so Focus cannot be measured here). Player::UpdateMaxPower truncates the product to an integer, so 1000 x 1.03 reads 1029 or 1030 and 100 x 1.03 reads 102 or 103. The script's earlier revision recomputed the Focus/Energy/Runic Power TOTAL_PCT modifier from scratch on every apply/remove and replaced the slot with SetStatPctModifier instead of composing, so it silently discarded or failed to restore any unrelated aura's own contribution to that same modifier slot. Templar's Sturdy (681009, SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_ENERGY_PERCENT MiscValue 3 = POWER_ENERGY, +5%, native handler, no module script binds it) is used as that unrelated aura: it shares the Energy TOTAL_PCT slot with Ionic Aura but is otherwise unconnected, so it proves the fix composes (apply) and restores (remove) rather than clobbering.

steps.label: Let spawn and level scaling settle
SETUP: the templar starts with the created Energy pool of 100
COLLISION SETUP: the templar learns Sturdy, an unrelated native aura on the same Energy TOTAL_PCT slot
COLLISION SETUP: Sturdy alone adds its native 5% to the templar's Energy
Ally maximum mana before Ionic Aura
Ally maximum Rage before Ionic Aura
Ally maximum Energy before Ionic Aura
Ally maximum Runic Power before Ionic Aura
SETUP: the ally starts with the created Energy pool of 100
SETUP: the ally starts with the created Runic Power pool of 1000
SETUP: the raid aura reaches the grouped ally
BASELINE: maximum mana gains the encoded 3%
BASELINE: maximum Rage gains the encoded 3% (1000 x 1.03)
DISCRIMINATING: maximum Energy gains 3% (100 x 1.03), where it stayed 100
DISCRIMINATING: maximum Runic Power gains 3% (1000 x 1.03), where it stayed 1000
COLLISION SETUP: the raid aura also reaches the templar
COLLISION DISCRIMINATING: Ionic Aura composes with Sturdy instead of replacing it (100 x 1.05 x 1.03 = 108.15); the pre-fix script clobbered Sturdy's 5% and read 103
SETUP: the raid aura leaves the ally
COLLISION DISCRIMINATING: removing Ionic Aura restores Sturdy's own 5%, not the pre-fix script's flat reset to 0%
Cleanup: remove the collision partner
DISCRIMINATING: the scripted Energy bonus is removed with the aura
DISCRIMINATING: the scripted Runic Power bonus is removed with the aura

The native mana bonus is removed with the aura
